name: adc-sandbox
description: ADC zone runtime connector: read-only cloud resource queries, the ADC job domain (templates, tasks, logs, data files, collect plans, mining and retrieval), plus read-only host and TKE triage. Write tools (create or dispatch a job, run host commands) are available but gated by two-phase confirmation and idempotency.
